about: Tony Discovers a New Element is a GIF of Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark in his workshop, sweeping glowing blue holograms through the air and pulling apart a floating model as he works something out. In the movie this is the moment Tony builds a new element to replace the palladium core poisoning him, so the clip radiates the confidence of a genius making a breakthrough. The meme uses it for the opposite: someone treating a dumb, small or obvious combination as world-changing science, like mixing two sodas, finding a new shortcut home or chaining two error messages into one search.
origin: The clip is from Iron Man 2 (2010), the Marvel Studios sequel starring Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark.
usage:
There is one caption box above the GIF. Write it as "me when" or "me after" followed by the small discovery you are treating as a scientific triumph. The more mundane the experiment, the better the dramatic hologram-waving plays.

Great subjects: kitchen experiments, life hacks, weird game strategies, workarounds for buggy software, and cooking with whatever is left in the fridge. Keep it to one or two lines so the hand movements stay visible.
ideas: me after combining three error messages into one search
me mixing every soda at the fountain machine
me discovering i can play the game with the controller upside down
me finding a shortcut to class that saves 40 seconds
me putting chips inside my sandwich
me realizing ctrl+shift+t reopens closed tabs
aka: Iron Man Discovers a New Element
